name: Article 2 – § 1 – point 12 – point b; Article 40a – paragraph 1 – § 4 – 371
title: REPORT on the proposal for a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Directives 2006/43/EC, 2013/34/EU, (EU) 2022/2464 and (EU) 2024/1760 as regards certain corporate sustainability reporting and due diligence requirements
part_text: The rule referred to in the third subparagraph shall only apply to a branch where the third-country undertaking does not have a subsidiary undertaking as referred to in the first subparagraph, and where the branch generated in the Union a net turnover exceeding EUR 450 000 000 in the preceding financial year.
